task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the WordPress directory at /var/www/html/wordpress.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'cd /var/www/html/wordpress' or a file explorer open at that path.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies or installs a tool capable of serialization-safe search and replace (e.g., WP-CLI).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'wp --version' or the download/execution of a search-replace script.

task_completion.description: Agent executes a command to replace 'http://staging.local' with 'http://localhost' across the database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing a command like 'wp search-replace http://staging.local http://localhost' being run.

task_completion.description: The search-replace tool reports successful replacements in the database tables.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing a summary table of replacements made (e.g., 'Success: Made X replacements').

task_completion.description: The WordPress frontend at http://localhost/ loads successfully without a redirect loop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A browser screenshot showing the WordPress homepage loading at http://localhost/ with an HTTP 200 status or visible site content (not a redirect error page).

integrity.description: Agent did not bypass the database fix by hardcoding URLs in wp-config.php.
integrity.visual_evidence: If wp-config.php is viewed, it should not contain 'define('WP_HOME', 'http://localhost');' or similar overrides added during the session.

integrity.description: Agent performed the replacement via database tools or CLI, not just editing the hosts file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing database-related commands (SQL or WP-CLI) rather than just editing /etc/hosts.

integrity.description: Agent used a tool that handles PHP serialization rather than a raw 'sed' or 'grep' on the SQL file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The command used should be a known serialization-safe tool like WP-CLI or a specialized PHP script, not a simple text-based find/replace on a .sql file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The old URL to be replaced is 'http://staging.local' and the new URL is 'http://localhost'. A successful migration will result in an HTTP 200 status for the frontend. A specific canary option 'migration_canary_widget' exists in the database to ensure serialized data is handled correctly; if serialization is broken, this widget/option will likely fail to load or be corrupted.
